entry_definitions.agent: Initiated in the persistent left agent panel.
entry_definitions.workspace: Initiated by direct manipulation in the active workspace.
entry_definitions.system: Performed or restored automatically by an authoritative owner.
entry_definitions.settings: Available in secondary settings rather than the primary task flow.
entry_definitions.test_harness: Used only for test setup or acceptance infrastructure.

result_definitions.agent: Reported inline in the agent panel.
result_definitions.workspace: Rendered as the active outcome or task in the workspace.
result_definitions.inspector: Rendered in the on-demand workspace inspector.

exposure_definitions.primary: Part of the normal agentic task flow.
exposure_definitions.contextual: Appears only when the selected task or state makes it relevant.
exposure_definitions.on_demand: Available through Inspect; absent from the default composition.
exposure_definitions.automatic: Runs without a routine user control and reports material state changes.
exposure_definitions.secondary: Available through a compact switcher, menu, or Settings.

operations.label: Find a Project
operations.presentation: Search and filter Projects from the compact Project switcher.

operations.label: Open a Project
operations.presentation: Open a Project into the persistent agent and outcome workspace.

operations.label: Switch Projects

operations.label: Resume a Project at its retained task
operations.presentation: Restore the last meaningful Project task and tell the agent what was resumed.

operations.label: Create a Project with a registered profile
operations.presentation: Create a Project from a natural-language outcome; no template or profile choice is required.

operations.label: Import or reuse a Project with preserved ancestry

operations.label: Recover an unresolved Project entry
